blocks.name: Barbara Jordan (1936–1996)
paras: Barbara Jordan was born in Houston, Texas. A gifted debater at Texas Southern University, she **earned a law degree** at Boston University and in 1966 **won election to the Texas Senate**; in 1972 she **entered the U.S. House of Representatives**, the first Black woman from the Deep South to do so. Her **deep, measured voice** became **her signature**.

In 1974, during the House Judiciary Committee’s impeachment hearings, she **delivered a statement** that **grounded** her arguments in the Constitution: “**My faith in the Constitution is whole; it is complete; it is total.**” In 1976 she **gave the keynote address** at the Democratic National Convention. She later **taught** at the University of Texas at Austin and died in 1996.
